clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind's Dwarven District, Shoni the Shilent prepares a fleet of tunneling machines for Dun Morogh. Short on parts, she sends you into Gnomeregan to salvage them from rogue automatons.

In Stormwind's Dwarven District, Shoni the Shilent prepares a fleet of gyrodrillmatic excavationators for Dun Morogh. Gnomish engineers there support their displaced kin, and Shoni's machines are meant to carry people and supplies underground. The massive rigs cannot work without the mechanical parts she still lacks.

Gnomeregan was the source of gnomish high technology, and its ruined halls and surrounding tunnels still hold machines worth salvaging. Malfunctioning defense bots, mechanical sentries, and clockwork laborers roam unchecked. Shoni sends you into the fallen city to gather two dozen bundles of robo-mechanical guts and bring them back to human lands.

Two dozen bundles of mechanical guts provide enough scrap to repair one excavationator. Shoni still has nearly four hundred machines to prepare, so mass subterranean transport remains a slow undertaking. Each functioning machine is a small step toward regaining ground lost in Gnomeregan's fall.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It's terrible, friend. We are not going to have enough parts to get our fleet of gyrodrillmatic excavationators to Dun Morogh.
What we need are spare parts, friend. What better place to get the spare parts for our vehicles than Gnomeregan? I hear that bots and mechs roam around that place like cattle on an open range.
What I need you to do is go to Gnomeregan and tear apart those robots. Bring me back their robot guts. Two dozen should be sufficient.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If this were a race, you would have lost by now.

clips.title: Completion
paras: This will do nicely, friend. One gyrodrillmatic excavationator fixed; 398 left to go.
